observations.humor_and_voices: Deliberate first-person Neet is consistent throughout: minty judgment, an unsolicited briefing, leaf-security escalation and clerical treatment of the absent rain carry his overconfidence. Buddy has independent comfort/food wants and choices: relocating out of whisper range, shaking off the leaf, skipping the begging procedure, monitoring Heather rather than performing a protest, then occupying the mattress footprint. His final refusal to move earns a physical punchline rather than another comment.
observations.causality_and_timing: Breeze explicitly moves the leaf to Buddy before he shakes it behind Neet; the picture does not anticipate that reversal. Buddy warns that facing away will miss Heather, causing Neet to return to the glass. Dessert appeases hunger but does not cure Neet's exclusion grievance, making the renewed protest coherent. Chill causes human retreat; Neet's rain prediction remains comically inaccurate.
observations.payoff: Midnight ear scratches and quiet forgiveness soften the inflated grievances; Buddy's carpet claim supplies the final concrete joke before the original affectionate ownership coda. Images do not interrupt or crowd this ending.

exact_state_placement.finding: Both humans brush through narrow doorway; Neet watches while Buddy still lies on rug. Correctly between observation and duel interpretation, before Buddy moves away.
Leaf remains on mulch under Neet's warning stance; Buddy is belly-up looking toward him, before side-roll/shoulder adhesion. No later action is prematurely shown.

Humans seated outside with food/candle; both dogs inside, Neet's paw on glass and Buddy oriented toward table. Correctly follows adjusted protest and precedes Heather returning with dessert; not confused with later mattress scene.

observations.complementarity: Warm low doorway surveillance, daylight full-body park confrontation and dusk glass-separated dining carry three distinct beats and spatial jokes. The repeated paw gesture later is handled in prose without duplicating the illustration.
observations.closed_findings: Visual review accepts exact current hashes and records actual reinspection of balcony v003. At reading size Buddy now has a close nape/neck/shoulder contour with regional ear and muzzle furnishings; no raised neck ruff or readable regression. No unresolved material narrative, placement or art finding found.

editorial_review.revision_note: Deliberate Neet first-person diary preserved, including timestamps, unreliable melodrama and TRAYTORZ. Neet wants to interpret threats and remain included; Buddy wants rest, park play and dessert and tests the door gap for his own practical reason. Tooth synchrony, cane/squirrel/bangs/leaf, soup/sheera protest, four-million-hair mattress, cold return and loyal closing retained. Removed one photo-conflicting tail assertion and narrator-described human worship without neutralizing Neet’s comic voice. Image: solemn leaf arrest with resting Buddy.
